card.name: Weigh/weighing before a weight cutoff
card.fires_on: The verb weigh or weighing in dosing population descriptions, right after an age group such as 'pediatric patients 12 years and older'. It comes just before a weight threshold like 40 kg or at least 35 kg.

modes.label: Weighing after 'and'
modes.description: The word weighing follows 'and' in an age-and-weight eligibility phrase.

modes.label: Weigh after 'who'
modes.description: The verb weigh follows 'who' in a relative clause about patients' weight.
